Define the location of the resulting bundle. By default it is a folder called `build`, adjacent to the [Remotion Root](/docs/terminology/remotion-root).

## CLI flag

Use `--out-dir` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                               | Flag                |
| ------------------------------------- | ------------------- |
| [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle) | `--out-dir <value>` |

## API and configuration references

| Reference                                          | Name                       |
| -------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
| [`bundle()`](/docs/bundle#outdir)                  | `outDir`                   |
| [Configuration file](/docs/config#setbundleoutdir) | `Config.setBundleOutDir()` |
